# Labor & Industries (L&I), Washington State

> Washington State's Department of Labor & Industries provides workers' compensation, workplace safety enforcement, labor standards protection, and trades licensing services.

L&I serves Washington State employers, workers, and contractors across major regions including Seattle, Spokane, Tacoma, and Tumwater. The agency administers workers' compensation insurance, enforces safety and health regulations, oversees apprenticeship programs, licenses electrical and other trades, and protects workers' civil rights and wages.

## Key Topics

- Workers' Compensation
- Workplace Safety & Health
- Labor Regulations & Standards
- Electrical Licensing
- Asbestos Removal
- Employer Services
- Claims Management
- Conveyance & Elevator Inspection
- Apprenticeship Programs
- Civil Rights Compliance
- Wage & Hour Enforcement
- Trade Licensing
- Safety Compliance
- Electronic Benefit Payment Services
